newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends lower after reaching new peak.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends lower after reaching new peak.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index ended lower on Wednesday after reversing opening gains into new high ground and running out of steam following a hefty four percent rise the previous four sessions.
UK equities had looked to Wall Street for fresh incentive to push higher but an unsteady start in New York dragged the FTSE back to the worst level of the day.

The FTSE 100 finished 14.8 points off at 4,724.8 after setting a new peak of 4,759.3. "Given the run we've had in the past few days it's fair enough that we should have a slight pause," said Ian Williams, equity strategist at Panmure Gordon.
